head: iSyn Tron brings back the 2009 iSyn groovebox for iPhone and iPad
dek: iSyn Tron rebuilds iSyn, a groovebox app from 2009, with its original sound engine: two synths and an 8-track drum machine. It was #81 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: Each synth has three oscillators, a filter, an arpeggiator and up to 8 voices; the drum machine has 8 kits including 808 and 909. It costs $4.99 with no in-app purchases, by Harry Gohs, and needs iOS 17.
means: If you made beats on iSyn years ago, the same sound is back on current iPhones.
todo: Find iSyn Tron in the App Store.
